mostWorthwhile.text: Recovering iron from worn blood cells and using it in the marrow was most worthwhile: it showed how old material can help make replacement cells.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting each finished renewal process to the body felt a little repetitive, although it made the final model complete.

surprise.text: I was surprised that iron from worn red cells could be recovered and used again to help make new ones.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary; the pictures and goals made the pairings understandable.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: seeing familiar body parts connected to ongoing processes was interesting, and I would be curious about another everyday body process.
